scope: Original code roles composed using this language glossary. Modern proposals, not historically attested compounds. No related-language fallback or opaque collision suffix.
naming_principles: Spanish head-first noun groups and verb-first actions; explicit device, execution and persistence roles.

verified_lexeme_history.history: Latin nucleus, diminutive of nux (nut), originally the inner edible part.
verified_lexeme_history.project_use: The central-core metaphor motivates the OS kernel name. This source supports the lexical root, not the history of the computing term.

rationale.원문: The existing source/fuente root is native to this language. Retaining it also preserves the independent delivery folder and the standard source shell command.
rationale.x86: Processor architecture name retained intact; x is not a horizontal-coordinate variable in these roles.
rationale.OpenJDK-소스빌드와-자체커널-이식: OpenJDK is a proper project name. Port here means adapting software to a kernel, not a network socket port.
